ns2:section.sectionText: SP25 - ENGL 325 / GWS 395 - Topics in LGBT Literature and Film - Kadin Henningsen - The emergence of “trans literature” in 2013 ushered in a new era of literary and cultural production not just for, but also by, and under the creative control of transgender people. This course explores the emerging field of transgender literature and cultural production across a range of forms and genres, from memoir (a staple of trans lit) to novels, shorts stories, and poetry, as well as films, comics, art, video games, and more to understand the diverse range of approaches to trans world making within contemporary literary and cultural production.
